We’re thrilled that you are interested in joining us here at the Amynta Group!
 
 
We’re thrilled that you are interested in joining PDP Group, an Amynta Group company. We are currently hiring for the position of Software Developer I at our Hunt Valley, MD location. 

The compensation for this position is a yearly salary between $60,000 to $70,000. This is a hybrid position with a 4 day in-office requirement at our Hunt Valley, MD office.

The Company offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) participation, paid time off, and holiday pay. Full-time position. Apply now! Position posted 8/31/2026.

The Software Developer I supports the development, maintenance, and enhancement of enterprise applications built on Microsoft .NET technologies, Azure-hosted Kubernetes environments, and DB2-integrated systems. This role focuses on learning the organization’s application ecosystem, resolving routine issues, and contributing to development efforts under the guidance of senior team members. 

The Software Developer I will work closely with Business Analyst and Product Owner to understand the business and technical requirements. We’re thrilled that you are interested in joining PDP Group, an Amynta Group company. We are currently hiring for the position of Software Developer I at our Hunt Valley, MD location. 

 The compensation for this position is a yearly salary between $60,000 to $70,000. This is a hybrid position with a 4 day in-office requirement at our Hunt Valley, MD office.
 


 Key Responsibilitie s
 • Assist in developing and maintaining features within .NET-based web applications, according to business and technical specifications provided.
 • Support application functionality deployed within Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) environments.
 • Assist with integration and data exchange between DB2 databases and .NET applications
 • Troubleshoot and resolve basic application defects and support tickets
 • Write and maintain application code following established coding standards
 • Assist with testing, debugging, and validation of application changes
 • Participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback from senior developers
 • Document application changes, configurations, and support procedures
 • Collaborate with QA, infrastructure, and business teams to understand requirements
 • Follow established SDLC, change management, and deployment processes

 Required Qualifications 
 • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent experience)
 • 1 to 3 years of professional application development or support experience
 • 1 to 3 years experience with:
 o C# and .NET (ASP.NET, .NET Core preferred)
 o SQL fundamentals
 o Entity framework or any other ORM
 o NextJS or equivalent experience in similar frameworks
 • Familiarity with:
 o Web application concepts (HTTP, APIs)
 o Source control systems (Git, Azure DevOps, or similar)
 o Micro services Architecture
 • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills and willingness to learn
 • Good written and verbal communication skills

 Preferred Qualifications 
 • Exposure to Azure services or cloud-hosted applications
 • Basic understanding of containerization (Docker) or Kubernetes concepts
 • Exposure to DB2 or other enterprise relational databases
 • Internship or academic project experience in enterprise application development
